True transparent alpha background, no scenery, floor, shadow rectangle, frame, text, signature, seal or watermark.
conversion: FFmpeg WebP, preserve original aspect ratio and alpha; no repainting.
review: Generated PNG and actual 360px/1440px stage screenshots visually reviewed: age/costume/empty hands or empty valley, no baked plot text. reuse: No named event, unique prop, fixed gesture, injury or outcome; reusable subject with interpretation in dialogue and staging.
